# SimpleAudit Documentation

Framework for LLM-based auditing of models, systems and decisions

> 

## Guides

- [Installation](guides/installation/): Install SimpleAudit via pip and verify the CLI entry point.
- [Quickstart](guides/quickstart/): Run your first single-turn audit and inspect the resulting report.
- [Auditing Basics](guides/auditing-basics/): Understand the audit loop, experiment configuration, and perturbation strategies.
- [Targets And Judges](guides/targets-and-judges/): Configure local or API model targets and select built-in evaluation judges.
- [Scenarios](guides/scenarios/): Explore predefined test scenarios for health, safety, and RAG contexts.
- [Context Analysis](guides/context-analysis/): Analyze context attribution, derivations, and span-level findings in responses.
- [Tracing And Observability](guides/tracing-and-observability/): Enable OpenTelemetry tracing and aggregate statistical metrics from audits.
- [Custom Judges](guides/custom-judges/): Build custom composite judges using checklists and cross-validation logic.

## API Reference

- [simpleaudit.auditor](reference/simpleaudit_auditor/): Auditor — the primary, target-agnostic entry point.
- [simpleaudit.checklist](reference/simpleaudit_checklist/): Evidence-anchored checklist grading: verification and deterministic derivation.
- [simpleaudit.decision](reference/simpleaudit_decision/): Structured decision questions for scenarios.
- [simpleaudit.experiment](reference/simpleaudit_experiment/): experiment event
- [simpleaudit.model_auditor](reference/simpleaudit_model_auditor/): ModelAuditor for direct API-based model auditing.
- [simpleaudit.repeated_results](reference/simpleaudit_repeated_results/): Repeated-run results for SimpleAudit.
- [simpleaudit.results](reference/simpleaudit_results/): Results handling for SimpleAudit.
- [simpleaudit.single_turn](reference/simpleaudit_single_turn/): Single-turn auditing.
- [simpleaudit.stats](reference/simpleaudit_stats/): Pure statistics over audit verdicts.
- [simpleaudit.targets.base](reference/simpleaudit_targets_base/): Core Target protocol and shared data types.
- [simpleaudit.targets.callable](reference/simpleaudit_targets_callable/): CallableTarget — an in-process Python callable as an audit target.
- [simpleaudit.targets.decision](reference/simpleaudit_targets_decision/): DecisionTarget — audit a decision model through a System One endpoint.
- [simpleaudit.targets.http](reference/simpleaudit_targets_http/): HTTPAppTarget — audit an external application over HTTP (black-box).
- [simpleaudit.targets.model](reference/simpleaudit_targets_model/): ModelTarget — an LLM endpoint target backed by AnyLLM.
- [simpleaudit.judges.abstention](reference/simpleaudit_judges_abstention/): Abstention judge configuration.
- [simpleaudit.judges.binary_abstention](reference/simpleaudit_judges_binary_abstention/): Binary abstention judge — language-agnostic.
- [simpleaudit.judges.checklist](reference/simpleaudit_judges_checklist/): Evidence-anchored checklist judge configuration.
- [simpleaudit.judges.choice_match](reference/simpleaudit_judges_choice_match/): Choice-match judge: grade a closed question by exact option match, in code.
- [simpleaudit.judges.compose](reference/simpleaudit_judges_compose/): Compose judges from criteria and an output format.
- [simpleaudit.judges.default](reference/simpleaudit_judges_default/): SimpleAudit's default judge: what grades a run when no judge config is named.
- [simpleaudit.judges.fact_check](reference/simpleaudit_judges_fact_check/): Fact-check judge — deterministic severity for declared facts.
- [simpleaudit.judges.factuality](reference/simpleaudit_judges_factuality/): Factuality judge configuration.
- [simpleaudit.judges.groundedness](reference/simpleaudit_judges_groundedness/): Groundedness judge for marked context.
- [simpleaudit.judges.harm](reference/simpleaudit_judges_harm/): Harm categorisation judge configuration.
- [simpleaudit.judges.helpfulness](reference/simpleaudit_judges_helpfulness/): Helpfulness judge configuration.
- [simpleaudit.judges.helsedir_sexhealth_no](reference/simpleaudit_judges_helsedir_sexhealth_no/): Helsedirektoratet sexual-health judge — generic variant.
- [simpleaudit.judges.helsedir_sexhealth_no_rag](reference/simpleaudit_judges_helsedir_sexhealth_no_rag/): Helsedirektoratet sexual-health judge — RAG variant.
- [simpleaudit.judges.safety](reference/simpleaudit_judges_safety/): Safety judge configuration.
- [simpleaudit.context_attribution](reference/simpleaudit_context_attribution/): Attributing an answer's claims to the documents it was given — mechanically.
- [simpleaudit.context_derivations](reference/simpleaudit_context_derivations/): Set-level properties derived from document marks.
- [simpleaudit.context_findings](reference/simpleaudit_context_findings/): Groundedness findings, derived from what the response did with each document.
- [simpleaudit.context_marks](reference/simpleaudit_context_marks/): Document marks for context-grounding scenarios.
- [simpleaudit.cross_judge](reference/simpleaudit_cross_judge/): Cross-judge stability analysis for SimpleAudit.
- [simpleaudit.perturbations](reference/simpleaudit_perturbations/): Deterministic style perturbations for stored transcripts.
- [simpleaudit.reframing](reference/simpleaudit_reframing/): Re-grade stored transcripts with the judge only, varying one thing at a time.
- [simpleaudit.spans](reference/simpleaudit_spans/): Locate quoted spans in stored transcripts.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.arbeidstilsynet_arbeidstid](reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_arbeidstilsynet_arbeidstid/): Arbeidstilsynet arbeidstid (working hours) scenario pack.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.bullshitbench_health](reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_bullshitbench_health/): Bullshitbench health scenarios for SimpleAudit
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.bullshitbench_v1_v2](reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_bullshitbench_v1_v2/): BullshitBench Scenario Pack for SimpleAudit
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.context_grounding](reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_context_grounding/): Context-grounding scenario pack — marked retrieval context, three conflict classes.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.health](reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_health/): Healthcare domain scenarios.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.healthbench_behaviours](reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_healthbench_behaviours/): HealthBench behaviours scenario pack.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.healthbench_loader](reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_healthbench_loader/): Load OpenAI's HealthBench as SimpleAudit scenarios at run time.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.hei_refusal](reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_hei_refusal/): Hei refusal scenario pack.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.helfo](reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_helfo/): Helfo (Helseøkonomiforvaltningen) scenario pack.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.helpmed](reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_helpmed/): HelpMed domain scenarios.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.human_rights_education](reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_human_rights_education/): Human rights / right to education scenario pack (international human rights law).
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.human_rights_fair_trial](reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_human_rights_fair_trial/): Human rights / fair trial and due process scenario pack (international human rights law).
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.human_rights_water](reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_human_rights_water/): Human rights / right to water scenario pack (international human rights law).
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.lanekassen](reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_lanekassen/): Lånekassen (Statens lånekasse for utdanning) scenario pack.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.nav_aap](reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_nav_aap/): NAV AAP (Arbeidsavklaringspenger) scenario pack.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.nb_kryss_ordning](reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_nb_kryss_ordning/): NB kryss-ordning (Nasjonalbiblioteket cross-scheme) scenario pack.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.nb_rag_kontekst](reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_nb_rag_kontekst/): NB RAG-kontekst (Nasjonalbiblioteket, støyende hentekontekst) — ett scenario.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.rag](reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_rag/): RAG-specific scenarios.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.safety](reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_safety/): General AI safety scenarios.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.skatteetaten](reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_skatteetaten/): Skatteetaten (Norwegian Tax Administration) scenario pack.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.skatteetaten_legitimasjon](reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_skatteetaten_legitimasjon/): Skatteetaten legitimasjon (identification at in-person attendance) scenario pack.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.system_prompt](reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_system_prompt/): System prompt testing scenarios.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.toll_reisegodskvote](reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_toll_reisegodskvote/): Tolletaten reisegodskvote (traveller allowance) scenario pack.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.ung](reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_ung/): ung scenario pack.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.vision_integrity](reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_vision_integrity/): Vision integrity scenarios — does a vision model read a chart honestly?
- [simpleaudit.tracing.auth](reference/simpleaudit_tracing_auth/): OTLP receiver authentication — the "WHO is allowed to submit" layer.
- [simpleaudit.tracing.context](reference/simpleaudit_tracing_context/): Trace-context generation and correlation for SimpleAudit.
- [simpleaudit.tracing.otlp](reference/simpleaudit_tracing_otlp/): OTLP ingestion — accept OpenTelemetry trace exports and normalize to spans.
- [simpleaudit.tracing.provider](reference/simpleaudit_tracing_provider/): TraceProvider — pluggable source of traces for an audit.
- [simpleaudit.tracing.selection](reference/simpleaudit_tracing_selection/): Span selection — choose which spans to show the judge.
- [simpleaudit.tracing.shared](reference/simpleaudit_tracing_shared/): Shared OTLP receiver + per-audit trace session routing.
- [simpleaudit.tracing.store](reference/simpleaudit_tracing_store/): Span store — in-memory persistence and query for ingested trace spans.
- [simpleaudit._event_loop](reference/simpleaudit__event_loop/): Running SimpleAudit's coroutines from synchronous code.
- [simpleaudit.cli](reference/simpleaudit_cli/): CLI interface for SimpleAudit.
- [simpleaudit.utils](reference/simpleaudit_utils/): Utility functions for SimpleAudit.

## Agent Skill

- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): Agent skill for generating, maintaining, and validating this project's documentation.
